steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Put me down... Put me down!

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: I'm a Legion warrior, not a good-for-nothing! There is something fishy about this inheritance. Let me fight!
As she yelps, Horo hits you repeatedly on the back with her limp fists. She has to stop after a short while to catch her breath before she can start again. Apparently, she is too weak to stand.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't waste your energy. Your only job is to point us the right direction. If your wounds reopen, you'll have to stay a good-for-nothing for another month.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: God, are Legion people all muscle and no brains? The lot of you are just like your boss, a bunch of brainless brutes.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Don't you dare bad-mouth my commander!
Anger rises inside her, and she starts strangling you again, strength returning to her hands all of a sudden.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Uh... sorry. I respect my commander, so I can't stand people saying anything bad...
The moment you can drop this act, you're gonna put the shackles on her. She's really doing your head in.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But she's really... really scary. I guess you can fill up the entire Syndicate with people cursing her behind her back. Don't you think so, ${PlayerName}?
Ouch... Ouch... Ouch... You're seeing stars now.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content:
Sorry, I did it again.
You little devil, I'll deal with you as soon as I'm back on my feet.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hahaha! We've got a brainless fangirl here. Hahaha! Ouch...
Hecate whacks Hella on the head, who finally gives it a rest.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: The Legion's enemies are numerous. You shouldn't pay any attention to any of those rumors. You've met my boss, you know what she's like.

Another bang comes from the direction of the central elevator. The whole crypt is shaking violently, with rocks and gravel raining down. It reminds you of that woman and her steely look with murderous malice.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: What's the matter? You look terrible.

options: Truth be told, I don't know what she's like.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Huh! That's a secret of the Legion. I can't just give it away.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Ha... It's good enough that only those in the Legion know my boss is a decent person.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Anyway, considering you'll join us sooner or later, I'm gonna give you a taste of what she's like.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: My boss was not among the first to join the Legion. It was not called that name before she joined, and I was not a Sinner.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: We were just a mercenary fleet on the outskirts, away from the urban area, hiding in the desert and surviving on commissions. Because the fleet was afraid of getting involved in battles.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Whenever we crossed paths with gangsters when they were plundering and looting, we kept our mouths shut and took a detour. When they came for us, all we could do was run away, make compromises, or beg for mercy.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: I was furious and wanted to take them on. But Earl stopped me at every turn. He said battles required strength, which we didn't have.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: So I was not happy when he took Boss Zoya on board, saying that we were to reform the fleet and build up our strength to fight back against the gang.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: That just meant I was not good enough, and I didn't deserve to be on the battlefield!
It appears that she was really infuriated.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: I was so pissed off, I went out to pick fights with gangsters, I came back to challenge her to a duel, all to prove that I was strong, I had what it took, that I could fight... Defeating her would be proof enough.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: It went on for a while, and then I got hit in the arm by a bullet, a Mania bullet. The contamination was spreading so fast that I would have to have my arm amputated. Before the amputation, I challenged her to a duel again.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: I thought that would be my last fight.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: My boss stopped Earl when he tried to intervene, and accepted my challenge. She took it seriously, and she knocked me down without mercy.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: She encouraged me to fight on. A lot of nonsense is happening in this world, but there's one thing that's certain: As long as you still want to shout and hold your head high, you have the right to fight.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: My battle was not over. She was waiting for me to get back on my feet.

options: And you did get back on your feet.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Yes, I did. I wasn't beaten by the contamination. I became a Sinner. The injury in my arm became my battle mark, and she my beacon.

options: ...I understand you. But do you understand her?

steps.content: What is she thinking? What is she fighting for? Her dogged determination to fight till the very end... is there some explanation for it other than her desire for destruction?

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: ...I don't know. There are many things... that my commander won't tell me about.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: But that's not important.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: It's she who showed me that I'm worthy of battlefields. She is my beacon, and for that reason, I'll follow her until the day I die.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: For her, I would do anything.

options: ...But you're putting yourself in great danger.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Of course you do!

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Our commander is fabulous and cool, isn't she? Whoever lays eyes on her is bound to succumb to her charms.
She reaches over your shoulder and takes your hand, giving it a few shakes with a flourish. A big smile brightens her face.
You've seen the dark side of the Syndicate. For those who've long been trapped in that darkness, a raging fire like Zoya must have proven even more irresistible.
But what is being fed to the fire so that its light can chase that darkness away? What will the fire consume along the way?

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Anyway, I've been having this feeling, and I'm now certain what it is all about... You're exactly the type of person that my boss most appreciates.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: You're weak, but you have the one quality she really admires.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Oh... You're the envy of me! You're so weak, but... Come back with me to the Legion when the battle is over... my boss will be delighted to see you!
She meant it. But at this very moment, what expression should you put on?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: "I would do anything"?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You almost lost your life. What if one day one of her battles leads to the destruction of your soul?

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: What are you talking about? Our goal has never changed, and it has always been a just cause!
The look in her eyes at this moment is pure and determined, which may make it all the more worrying.
Stubbornly following a stubborn person... Where will this path lead her?

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: You have something against my boss, don't you?

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: It doesn't matter. People like her are a rare breed. There are plenty of people who don't see eye to eye with her.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: I'm just saying. It's a bit of a shame. You're totally the type of person that my boss would appreciate.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: You're much weaker than me, but there's something about you that she likes... a lot.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: She would be dying to get you on board.
She meant it. But all you can do is to remain silent.
Hehe... Pity that you won't live to see the day...

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Who's there?!
Before you have time to turn your heads, a stink grenade explodes behind you. From the pall of contamination-rich dust emerges several gangsters.

steps.speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
steps.content: Hehe... Lackeys of the Legion, thanks for leading the way...

steps.speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
steps.content: You can die now...
